::: {#exr-autograd-slope}

#### Asking PyTorch for the slope

Write a function that computes $\empriskf{\param}$ with PyTorch operations.
Make $\param = 5$ a [tensor](#def-tensor) created with `requires_grad=True`,
compute $\empriskf{5}$,
and pass both to [`torch.autograd.grad`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.autograd.grad.html).

:::
